title: hypobathrum coniocarpum
intro: Hypobathrum coniocarpum, commonly known as the "Sarang Bati" or "Bathrum coniocarpum," is a plant species belonging to the family Rubiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems due to its health benefits of acting as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Hypobathrum coniocarpum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids that exhibit anti-bacterial, anti-viral, and anti-fungal properties. Additionally, the plant's bioactive constituents help in reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and providing overall well-being.
